source.document: Manuli Hydraulics ferrule range — MULTIFIT type overview matrix plus the seven per-series dimension sheets supplied by the brand owner
source.note: Part references, DN / dash / inch bores and the D (outside diameter) and L (length) columns are transcribed verbatim from the seven dimension sheets. Where the overview matrix and a dimension sheet disagree on which sizes a series covers, the dimension sheet wins — it names the actual part reference. Nothing outside those sheets is asserted: no pressure rating, material or surface-treatment claim appears anywhere in this payload because the sheets state none.

hub.name: Ferrules
hub.shortDescription: Manuli hydraulic hose ferrules by part-reference series — skive and no-skive constructions for wire braid, wire spiral, textile braid and compact hoses, DN5 to DN102 (3/16" to 4").
hub.seoTitle: Manuli Hose Ferrules — Skive & No-Skive Series | UAE
hub.seoDescription: Manuli hydraulic hose ferrule series stocked in Dubai: M00110, M00910, M03300, M03400, M03500, M00310 and M00820 families. Full DN, dash and dimension tables per series.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli MULTIFIT skive ferrules for wire braid hydraulic hoses — part references M00120, M00130 and M00110 across DN5 to DN51 (3/16" to 2").
series.categorySeoTitle: Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 Skive Ferrules
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli MULTIFIT skive ferrules for wire braid hose, DN5 to DN51. Full part reference, bore and dimension table for the M00110, M00120 and M00130 range.
series.title: Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M00110 / M00120 / M00130 Skive Ferrule — Wire Braid
series.seoDescription: Manuli MULTIFIT skive ferrule for wire braid hydraulic hose. Eleven sizes, DN5 to DN51 (3/16" to 2"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M00110 / M00120 / M00130 range is Manuli's MULTIFIT skive ferrule for wire braid hydraulic hoses. The hose cover is skived back before crimping, so the ferrule closes directly onto the wire reinforcement.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli skive ferrules for wire braid and wire spiral hydraulic hoses — part references M00910, M00920 and M00930 across DN5 to DN51 (3/16" to 2").
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli skive ferrules for wire braid and spiral hose, DN5 to DN51. Full part reference, bore and dimension table for the M00910, M00920 and M00930 range.
series.title: Manuli M00910 / M00920 Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M00910 / M00920 Skive Ferrule — Braid & Spiral
series.seoDescription: Manuli skive ferrule for wire braid and wire spiral hydraulic hose. Twelve sizes, DN5 to DN51 (3/16" to 2"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M00910 / M00920 range is Manuli's skive ferrule for wire braid and wire spiral hydraulic hoses. It runs a larger outside diameter than the MULTIFIT M00110 family at the same bore, which is what lets it carry spiral reinforcement as well as braid.
series.note: The dimension sheet for this family also lists M00930-16 at DN25 and two M00920 references at DN10 and DN19 — both are shown in the table below.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli M03300 no-skive ferrules for wire braid hydraulic hoses — the small-bore end of the range, DN5 to DN12 (3/16" to 1/2").
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli M03300 no-skive ferrules for wire braid hose, DN5 to DN12. Full part reference, bore and dimension table for the five sizes in the series.
series.title: Manuli M03300 No-Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M03300 No-Skive Ferrule — Wire Braid Hose
series.seoDescription: Manuli M03300 no-skive ferrule for wire braid hydraulic hose. Five sizes, DN5 to DN12 (3/16" to 1/2"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M03300 is Manuli's compact no-skive ferrule for wire braid hydraulic hoses. It crimps straight over the hose cover, and it is the shortest ferrule in the range at every bore it covers — 22.0 mm at DN5 against 23.9 mm for the MULTIFIT skive equivalent.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli M03400 no-skive ferrules for wire braid hydraulic hoses — the widest-spanning series in the range, DN5 to DN102 (3/16" to 4").
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli M03400 no-skive ferrules for wire braid hose, DN5 to DN102. Full part reference, bore and dimension table including the M03450 variant.
series.title: Manuli M03400 No-Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M03400 No-Skive Ferrule — DN5 to DN102
series.seoDescription: Manuli M03400 no-skive ferrule for wire braid hydraulic hose. Seventeen sizes, DN5 to DN102 (3/16" to 4"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M03400 is Manuli's no-skive ferrule for wire braid hydraulic hoses and the widest-spanning series in the ferrule range — it is the only one that carries on past DN51, running all the way to DN102 (4").
series.note: The dimension sheet also lists M03450-08, a second DN12 reference with a larger outside diameter (30.3 mm) and a shorter body (31.0 mm) than the M03400-08. Both are shown below.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli M03500 no-skive ferrules for wire spiral hydraulic hoses — DN10 to DN31 (3/8" to 1.1/4"), the only no-skive series in the range cut for spiral reinforcement.
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli M03500 no-skive ferrules for wire spiral hose, DN10 to DN31. Full part reference, bore and dimension table for the six sizes in the series.
series.title: Manuli M03500 No-Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M03500 No-Skive Ferrule — Wire Spiral Hose
series.seoDescription: Manuli M03500 no-skive ferrule for wire spiral hydraulic hose. Six sizes, DN10 to DN31 (3/8" to 1.1/4"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M03500 is Manuli's no-skive ferrule for wire spiral hydraulic hoses. It is the only no-skive series in the range cut for spiral reinforcement, and it starts at DN10 rather than DN5 — the smaller bores are covered by the braid series instead.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli no-skive ferrules for textile braid hydraulic hoses — part references M00310 and M00321 across DN5 to DN31 (3/16" to 1.1/4").
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli no-skive ferrules for textile braid hose, DN5 to DN31. Full part reference, bore and dimension table for the M00310 and M00321 range.
series.title: Manuli M00310 / M00320 No-Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M00310 / M00320 No-Skive Ferrule — Textile Braid
series.seoDescription: Manuli no-skive ferrule for textile braid hydraulic hose. Nine sizes, DN5 to DN31 (3/16" to 1.1/4"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M00310 / M00320 range is Manuli's no-skive ferrule for textile braid hydraulic hoses — the low- and medium-pressure return, suction and lubrication lines where the reinforcement is fibre rather than wire.
series.note: The DN19 (3/4") size in this family carries the reference M00321-12 on the dimension sheet rather than an M00320 number; it is shown below exactly as the sheet lists it.

series.categoryShortDescription: Manuli no-skive ferrules for compact hydraulic hoses — part references M00820 and M00830 across DN5 to DN51 (3/16" to 2").
series.categorySeoDescription: Manuli no-skive ferrules for compact hose, DN5 to DN51. Full part reference, bore and dimension table for the M00820 and M00830 range.
series.title: Manuli M00820 / M00830 No-Skive Ferrule
series.seoTitle: Manuli M00820 / M00830 No-Skive Ferrule — Compact Hose
series.seoDescription: Manuli no-skive ferrule for compact hydraulic hose. Eleven sizes, DN5 to DN51 (3/16" to 2"), with outside diameter and length for every part reference.
series.intro: The M00820 / M00830 range is Manuli's no-skive ferrule for compact hydraulic hoses. It runs the smallest outside diameter of any series here — 14.0 mm at DN5 against 19.2 mm for the M03300 — which is the point of a compact assembly: it fits routing a standard braid ferrule will not.
